text:
Posted by Lawrence Diaz 22 pm Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. (NASDAQ:TNXP) Ratings Coverage

Tonix Pharmaceuticals had 2 analyst reports since July 27, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Neutral” rating by Roth Capital on Friday, July 27. The stock increased 0.42% or $0.009 during the last trading session, reaching $2.139. About 78,194 shares traded. Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. (NASDAQ:TNXP) has declined 92.80% since January 11, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 92.80% the S&P500.
Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. engages in developing pharmaceutical and biological products to address public health challenges. The company has market cap of $3.27 million. The Company’s lead product candidate, TNX-102 SL or Tonmya, designed as a bedtime treatment for posttraumatic stress disorder , which is in Phase 3 study in the military-related PTSD population. It currently has negative earnings. The firm is also developing TNX-601 (tianeptine oxalate), a clinical candidate at pre-IND (investigational new drug) application stage, designed as a daytime treatment for posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD); and TNX-801, a live synthetic version of horsepox virus, at the pre-IND application stage.
